# Brand Connector Pro (Magic Manta)

Brand Connector Pro at https://magicmanta.com finds and verifies a company's social media profiles from its website URL.

## How it works
- Enter a brand's domain on the homepage to retrieve associated social handles across X, Instagram, LinkedIn, and other platforms.
- Profiles declared through JSON-LD/Schema.org sameAs or official-site DOM links get a Verified badge with the evidence source shown.
- Search fallback candidates stay Unverified; the app checks whether they link back to the official domain.
- Conflicts between official sources are flagged; each result shows "last checked".
- One-click copying for individual handles or the whole set.

## Pages
- / — single domain lookup
- /batch — look up multiple domains
- /dossier — result dossier view
- /source — source board
- /adapters — integration options (MCP available now; REST endpoint and React SDK are marked coming soon)
- /auth — sign in or create an account
- /pricing — plans and prices
- /fair-use — usage limits and fair-use policy
- /support — support form (signed-in users) and support email
- /licenses — open source credits and digital carbon disclosure
- /offline — offline fallback

## MCP server
- Endpoint: https://magicmanta.com/mcp (MCP Streamable HTTP)
- Auth-gated: unauthenticated requests return HTTP 401 {"error":"unauthorized"}.
- Authentication: OAuth 2.0 bearer tokens. Discovery metadata: https://magicmanta.com/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource
- MCP clients run the OAuth flow, which sends the user to sign in at https://magicmanta.com/auth and approve access. Sign-in options: Google, Apple, Microsoft, AgentID, or email and password. Accounts require an authenticator app (two-factor) before access is granted.
- Tools: lookup_socials (find a site's social profiles with evidence), list_my_lookups (the user's 50 most recent saved lookups), list_my_lists (the user's saved lists).

## Machine-readable
- /llms.txt — this file
- /.well-known/agent.json — agent card
- /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource — OAuth metadata for the MCP endpoint
- /carbon.txt — digital carbon disclosure (carbon.txt v0.5)
- /sitemap.xml and /robots.txt

## Limits
- No public REST API exists today; /api/public/radar is not available.
- The @magicmanta/react SDK is not published yet.
- The website lookup works without signing in; saved lookups, lists, paid plans and the MCP server require an account.
- MCP lookups are capped at 100 per account per day. Plan limits are described at /pricing and /fair-use.
- Automated use should be polite: sequential requests, cache where possible.
